نتعالق (form VI)
# نَتَعَالَقُ (nataʕālaqu) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# نَتَعَالَقَ (nataʕālaqa) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
# نَتَعَالَقْ (nataʕālaq) /na.ta.ʕaː.laq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَالَقَ (taʕālaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
